Introduction:
Once upon a time two friends went on a journey. They had to go through a forest on the way. As they went through the woods, they saw a bear.

Continuation:
Both of them became frightened. One of the friends climbed a tree and assured his tree. The other friend, having no time and not knowing how to climb, lay flat on his face without breathing or movement. Because he knew bears cannot suspect for attack dead bodies. The bear approached him, sniffed and went away.

The friend who climbed up the tree, approached the bother friend and tried to lighten the situation. He asked his friend, "what did the bear whisper in your ear?"

The other friend said, "He gave me a good piece of advice."

"What is it?" He asked.

The other friend said, "The bear told me that a friend in need is a friend indeed."

The friend regretted his actions and realized his mistake. He promised to never betray anyone again.

answers.transcript:
The Annual Prize-Giving ceremony, a solemn and prestigious ocassion to honour the academic and co-curricular excellence of our school, was held on the 29th January 2026 on the school compound. The school compound was decorated elegantly. The ceremony was graced by Prof. Dr. Ekramul Haque, the honourable chief guest Vice-Chancellor of Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) as the Chief Guest along with the chairman of our Governing body and other honourable dignitaries.

The ceremony started with the recitation from the Holy Quran. After the recitation, the Principal gave a warm welcome address to all present. The speech emphasized on the importance of diligence, persistance and devotion to studies. After the speech, our hosts, Md. Johangir Alam and Rowshan Akther, our Bangla and Biology teacher respectively called out the recipients and the chief guest gave away the prizes.

I was deeply honoured to receive two crests and certificates. After the conclusion of the formal meeting, there was an outstanding cultural show that consisted of a Rabindra Sangeet, Nazrul Geet, Poetry and drama and recent songs.

The ceremony left a profound impact on all present and inspired us to strive for greater achievements.
answers.student_title: Annual Prize-Giving Day of My School

Myself: Good morning, Sheila! Have you recieved your annual examination results yet?
Sheila: Good morning to you too. Yes, I have. I must admit that I was quite anxious before hand.
Myself: That is entirely understandable. I felt a similiar sense of unease myself. May I ask how you performed?
sheila: I am glad to report that my result was highly satisfactory. I have gotte more marks in most subjects than I had anticipated. Although my performance in Mathematics failed me.
Myself: Your result is outstanding. Mathematics was very not demanding this year. Interestingly, I had fared better in that subject than I thought.
Sheila: That is expected. I recall how diligently you worked to improve in Mathematics throughout the year.
Myself: Indeed. Perseverance and effort appears to have borne fruit.
Sheila: How did you perform in the standings.
Myself: I am pleased to report that I have secured first position in the class. And you?
sheila: I have secured second position though I was ahead of you in some subjects.
Myself: It's okay. let us always hope for the best. By the way, how did your parents acknowledge your results?
sheila: They were extremely proud and advised me to devote myself more in my studies and maintain this performance in the future.
Myself: Same to myself. Let us promise to fulfill the wishes of our parents and strive for greatness.
Sheila: Ameen. Thank you for the motivational advice, my friend.
Myself: You're very much welcome. Bye!
Sheila: Bye!
The end
answers.student_title: A dialogue between Myself and Sheila about our last annual examination result.
